title: Dashboard shell and window layout
description: As a Product Owner or team member, I want the same dashboard in web and desktop builds with clear failures and independent scrolling.
acceptance_criteria: Requirement mapping: DSH-01, DSH-01.a-f, DSH-01.g, DSH-15, DSH-15.a-c, UIC-01, UIC-12, UIC-13, UIC-21, UIC-24, DEF-01, THM-02. Web and desktop use the shared data interface. Reload refreshes sprint, requirements, issues, and progress. Loading or tracker failures show a reason only in their affected area. Labels use cited message keys and translations. Light and dark themes use THM-02 tokens. The page does not scroll; the board and lower columns use independent scroll areas. Test at 1920x1080 and 1280x720 for overflow.

title: Local sprint server
description: As a Product Owner or team member, I want the local sprint, requirement, issue, and progress data read and written safely without credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Requirement mapping: DSH-02, DSH-02.a-f, DSH-13, DSH-13.a-i, DSH-01.a. The server binds to the local address and DEF-01 port and rejects unlisted HTTP requests. Host and Origin follow DSH-13.a. Sprint sections and unrelated text are preserved. Missing sprint files are empty until the first change. Status changes follow DSH-13.c. Issue commands run without shells and return UTF-8 text. No token or secret is stored.

title: Requirement browser and outline
description: As a Product Owner or team member, I want to browse, filter, and expand requirements so I can find and plan the work that matters.
acceptance_criteria: Requirement mapping: DSH-03, DSH-03.a-c, DSH-04, DSH-04.a-d, DSH-11, DSH-11.a-f, UIC-21, UIC-12, UIC-13. Requirement rows include ID, status, statement, and feature. Feature, requirement, and status filters combine with AND. Parent rows expand and collapse; unlisted parents have standalone children. The count and expand-all control use the specified message keys.

title: Sprint planning board and drag operations
description: As a Product Owner or team member, I want to organize sprint blocks and drag requirements and issues through allowed states.
acceptance_criteria: Requirement mapping: DSH-02, DSH-06, DSH-06.a-e, DSH-07, DSH-07.a-h, DSH-08, DSH-08.a-b, DSH-10, DSH-10.a-c, DEF-01. Create and nest story, epic, and sprint blocks. Allow only DSH-defined drops and status transitions. Update estimates and usage; aggregate epic and sprint totals and use warn for usage above estimate. Accept only a story inside a sprint.

title: Issue list and issue creation
description: As a Product Owner or team member, I want to view and create issues linked to features and requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Requirement mapping: DSH-05, DSH-05.a-e, DSH-09, DSH-09.a-g, DSH-11.g-i, UIC-21, UIC-12, UIC-13. Show open issue metadata and shared filters. Keep issue data on failures. Create issue labels and requirement text exactly as specified. Group issues by feature and collapse or expand feature groups.

title: Agent progress and usage chart
description: As a team member, I want to compare agent progress and usage readings with estimates.
acceptance_criteria: Requirement mapping: DSH-12, DSH-12.a-d, DSH-14, DSH-14.a-g, DEF-01. Read progress files repeatedly and on Reload. Invalid or missing progress and usage data follow the specified empty states. Render 5-hour and 7-day meters, before/after bars, estimate bands, projections, and values above 100.

title: Shared add popup
description: As a Product Owner or team member, I want one shared add popup for blocks, requirements, and issues.
acceptance_criteria: Requirement mapping: DSH-16, DSH-16.a-j, DSH-09.d, UIC-01, UIC-24, UIC-27, DEF-01. Provide accessible add controls and shared popup fields. Rank local suggestions without outside services. Validate and create requirement or issue IDs and records only as DSH-16 requires.
